name: my-reader-monorepo
description: Local-first cross-platform ebook reader for Calibre and MyReader-managed libraries.

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.cjs .dependency-cruiser.cjs my-reader/src my-reader-mobile/src my-reader-mobile/modules packages scripts --max-warnings 0
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter my-reader exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter my-reader-mobile exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @my-reader/fonts typecheck && pnpm --filter @my-reader/tools typecheck && pnpm --filter @my-reader/i18n typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:qa && pnpm test:fonts && pnpm test:i18n && pnpm test:tools && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm test:mobile
scripts.qa: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm qa:architecture && pnpm qa:duplicates && pnpm qa:docs && pnpm qa:generated && pnpm test:qa
scripts.qa:coverage: pnpm --filter @my-reader/fonts test:coverage && pnpm --filter @my-reader/i18n test:coverage && pnpm --filter @my-reader/tools test:coverage && pnpm --filter my-reader test:unit:coverage && pnpm --filter my-reader-mobile test:coverage
scripts.qa:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings -D clippy::cognitive_complexity && cargo test --locked --workspace
scripts.qa:rust:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('reports/rust', { recursive: true })" && cargo llvm-cov --locked -p my-reader-core -p my-reader-core-ffi --lcov --output-path reports/rust/lcov.info
